question: Which among the following dance forms is a unique dance form as the performers are dressed as women and is popular in the parts of Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gotipua.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gotipua** is a unique dance form from the state of **Odisha** where **young boys** are dressed up as** women** and perform **acrobatic dance moves. **
 
• It was traditionally performed in **temples** and was a way of offering devotion to **Lord Jagannath.**
 
• Gotipua literally means** "single boy"** and the performers are usually between the ages of** 6 to 14 years old.**
 
• The dance form was popularized in the **16th century **by the poet and saint **Chaitanya Mahaprabhu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fugdi** is a folk dance form from the western Indian state of** Goa** and is performed by women during weddings and other celebrations.

 
 
• Fugdi is usually performed by** women in a circle formation** and is accompanied by traditional Goan music.
 
 
 
• **Theyyam** is a popular **ritualistic dance** form from the northern parts of **Kerala.**
 
 
• It is performed by **men** dressed up in elaborate costumes.
 
 
 
• **Bihu** is a folk dance form from the state of **Assam **and is performed during the **Bihu festival.**
 
 
• **​**It is performed by both** men and women** and is characterized by **energetic dance moves.**
 
• Bihu is a celebration of the** harvest season** and is performed with traditional musical instruments like the **dhol, pepa and gogona.**
